Name: (CP) Bigger Easter Eggs
Author: EmissaryOfWind
Description:
A replacer for the eggs in the egg hunt. Requires Content Patcher.

Installation:
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- Unzip this mod and drop the contents in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

Mods featured:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]
